title: "Dashboard"
subtitle: "Filter the recalls any way you like. Every panel updates together."
page-layout: full

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "site_setup.R"))

# One row per notice in each country's trend window. Within each event the US
# notice comes first, so the dashboard counts it once (using the US record)
# when both countries are selected.
dash <- trend |>
  arrange(event_id, desc(source == "US CPSC"), recall_date) |>
  transmute(record_id, event_id, country, recall_year, case_status,
            product_form, failed_component, hazard_group, is_ebike_related,
            units_recalled, title, url)

comp_order <- dash |>
  count(failed_component, sort = TRUE) |>
  pull(failed_component)
comp_order <- c(setdiff(comp_order, "Other or unclear"), "Other or unclear")

form_order <- c("Complete bicycle", "Complete e-bike", "Component", "Accessory",
                "E-bike battery, charger, or power part", "Unclear")

ojs_define(
  recs = dash,
  meta = list(
    maxYear     = this_year,
    minYear     = 2000,
    forms       = intersect(form_order, unique(dash$product_form)),
    components  = comp_order,
    hazards     = c("Fall or crash", "Fire or burn", "Laceration", "Other"),
    lastUpdated = format(max(recalls$recall_date), "%d %B %Y")
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Shared chart settings from the brand kit (colours, ebPlot, Space Mono axes)
import {eb, ebPlot, ebCatFill} from "./js/eb_charts.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
data = transpose(recs)
maxYear = [].concat(meta.maxYear)[0]
minYear = [].concat(meta.minYear)[0]
lastUpdated = [].concat(meta.lastUpdated)[0]
forms = [].concat(meta.forms)
components = [].concat(meta.components)
hazards = [].concat(meta.hazards)
hazardColors = ebCatFill.slice(0, 4)   // cobalt, tomato, sunflower, kelp
fmtN = d3.format(",")

// Set a filter control from code (used by the heatmap and the reset button)
setInput = (input, value) => {
  input.value = value;
  input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
}

// Search text for each recall event: the titles of every notice in it, so a
// joint recall matches a word in either the US or the Canadian title
eventText = d3.rollup(data, v => v.map(d => `${d.title} ${d.product_form} ${d.failed_component} ${d.hazard_group}`).join(" ").toLowerCase(), d => d.event_id)

// Countries reporting each recall event (joint events have both)
eventCountries = d3.rollup(data, v => new Set(v.map(d => d.country)), d => d.event_id)
```

::: {.panel-sidebar}

[Filters]{.sidebar-heading}

```{ojs}
viewof query = Inputs.text({label: "Search notices", placeholder: "Brand, product, or part"})
viewof countries = Inputs.checkbox(["United States", "Canada"], {label: "Country", value: ["United States", "Canada"]})
viewof yearFrom = Inputs.range([minYear, maxYear], {step: 1, value: minYear, label: "From"})
viewof yearTo = Inputs.range([minYear, maxYear], {step: 1, value: maxYear, label: "To"})
viewof form = Inputs.select(["All", ...forms], {label: "What was recalled"})
viewof component = Inputs.select(["All", ...components], {label: "Failed part"})
viewof hazard = Inputs.select(["All", ...hazards], {label: "Hazard"})
viewof ebikeOnly = Inputs.toggle({label: "E-bike related only", value: false})
viewof includeProbable = Inputs.toggle({label: "Include probable cases", value: true})
viewof measure = Inputs.radio(["Recall events", "Units recalled"], {label: "Count", value: "Recall events"})
viewof view = Inputs.radio(["By hazard", "By failed part"], {label: "Chart", value: "By hazard"})
viewof reset = Inputs.button("Reset all filters", {reduce: () => {
  setInput(viewof query, "");
  setInput(viewof countries, ["United States", "Canada"]);
  setInput(viewof yearFrom, minYear);
  setInput(viewof yearTo, maxYear);
  setInput(viewof form, "All");
  setInput(viewof component, "All");
  setInput(viewof hazard, "All");
  setInput(viewof ebikeOnly, false);
  setInput(viewof includeProbable, true);
}})
```

:::

::: {.panel-fill}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
lo = Math.min(yearFrom, yearTo)

// Search words: a notice must contain every word (in any order)
terms = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length)
hi = Math.max(yearFrom, yearTo)

// Does a notice pass the filters? "skip" leaves some filters out, so the
// heatmap and the country chart can show the full picture around a selection.
passes = (d, skip = []) =>
  (skip.includes("country") || countries.includes(d.country)) &&
  d.recall_year >= lo && d.recall_year <= hi &&
  (form === "All" || d.product_form === form) &&
  (skip.includes("component") || component === "All" || d.failed_component === component) &&
  (skip.includes("hazard") || hazard === "All" || d.hazard_group === hazard) &&
  (!ebikeOnly || d.is_ebike_related) &&
  (includeProbable || d.case_status === "confirmed") &&
  terms.every(t => eventText.get(d.event_id).includes(t))

// One row per recall event (the US notice, where there is one, comes first)
uniqueEvents = rows => {
  const seen = new Set();
  return rows.filter(d => {
    if (seen.has(d.event_id)) return false;
    seen.add(d.event_id);
    return true;
  });
}

filtered = uniqueEvents(data.filter(d => passes(d)))
heatRows = uniqueEvents(data.filter(d => passes(d, ["component", "hazard"])))
countryRows = uniqueEvents(data.filter(d => passes(d, ["country"]) && d.recall_year >= 2008))

w = d => measure === "Recall events" ? 1 : (d.units_recalled ?? 0)
measureLabel = measure === "Recall events" ? "recall events" : "units recalled"
years = d3.range(lo, hi + 1)
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!terms.length) return html``;
  const clear = html`<button type="button" class="dash-clear">Clear search</button>`;
  clear.onclick = () => setInput(viewof query, "");
  const note = html`<div class="dash-search-note"><span>Showing recalls matching <strong>${query.trim()}</strong>. Counts reflect how much a company sells and how readily it recalls, as well as product safety, so they are not a safety ranking.</span></div>`;
  note.append(clear);
  return note;
}
```

```{ojs}
tiles = {
  const n = filtered.length;
  const fall = n ? filtered.filter(d => d.hazard_group === "Fall or crash").length / n : 0;
  const ranked = d3.rollups(filtered.filter(d => d.failed_component !== "Other or unclear"),
                            v => v.length, d => d.failed_component)
                   .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const top = ranked.length ? ranked[0] : ["None", 0];
  const eb = n ? filtered.filter(d => d.is_ebike_related).length / n : 0;
  const units = d3.sum(filtered, d => d.units_recalled ?? 0);
  const pct = x => `${Math.round(100 * x)}%`;
  return html`<div class="stat-row dash-tiles">
    <div class="stat-box"><span class="num">${fmtN(n)}</span> <span class="lab">recall events (${fmtN(units)} units)</span></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><span class="num">${pct(fall)}</span> <span class="lab">fall or crash hazard</span></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><span class="num">${n ? pct(top[1] / n) : "0%"}</span> <span class="lab">top failed part: ${top[0].toLowerCase()}</span></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><span class="num">${pct(eb)}</span> <span class="lab">e-bike related</span></div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
totals = years.map(y => ({year: y, total: d3.sum(filtered.filter(d => d.recall_year === y), w)}))

// Three-year trailing average, leaving out the current (partial) year
rolling = totals
  .filter(t => t.year < maxYear)
  .map((t, i, arr) => i < 2 ? null : {year: t.year, avg: d3.mean(arr.slice(i - 2, i + 1), d => d.total)})
  .filter(Boolean)

byHazard = years.flatMap(y => hazards.map(h => ({
  year: y,
  hazard: h,
  value: d3.sum(filtered.filter(d => d.recall_year === y && d.hazard_group === h), w)
})))

byPart = components.flatMap(c => years.map(y => ({
  component: c,
  year: y,
  value: d3.sum(filtered.filter(d => d.recall_year === y && d.failed_component === c), w)
})))
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="dash-chart-title">${view === "By hazard"
  ? `${measure} per year, by hazard`
  : `${measure} per year, by failed part (same scale in every panel)`}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (view === "By hazard") {
    const fig = ebPlot(Plot, {
      width,
      height: 380,
      marginLeft: 56,
      marginTop: 20,
      x: {label: null, tickFormat: "d", domain: [lo, hi + 1]},
      y: {label: measure === "Recall events" ? "Recall events per year" : "Units recalled per year", grid: true, tickFormat: "~s"},
      color: {domain: hazards, range: hazardColors, legend: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.rectY(byHazard, {
          x: "year", interval: 1, y: "value", fill: "hazard",
          fillOpacity: d => d.year === maxYear ? 0.45 : 1,
          insetLeft: 1, insetRight: 1, stroke: eb.ink, strokeWidth: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: d => `${d.year}${d.year === maxYear ? " (partial year)" : ""}\n${d.hazard}: ${fmtN(Math.round(d.value))} ${measureLabel}`
        }),
        Plot.lineY(rolling, {x: d => d.year + 0.5, y: "avg", stroke: eb.ink, strokeWidth: 2, curve: "monotone-x"}),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    });
    const wrap = html`<div class="dash-chart"></div>`;
    wrap.append(fig);
    return wrap;
  }
  const maxV = d3.max(byPart, d => d.value) || 1;
  const grid = html`<div class="small-multiples"></div>`;
  for (const c of components) {
    const rows = byPart.filter(d => d.component === c);
    const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d.value);
    const p = ebPlot(Plot, {
      width: 300, height: 130, marginLeft: 40, marginTop: 8,
      x: {domain: [lo, hi + 1], tickFormat: "d", ticks: 4, label: null},
      y: {domain: [0, maxV], ticks: 3, label: null, grid: true, tickFormat: "~s"},
      marks: [
        Plot.rectY(rows, {
          x: "year", interval: 1, y: "value", fill: "#e3c600", stroke: eb.ink, strokeWidth: 0.4,
          fillOpacity: d => d.year === maxYear ? 0.45 : 1,
          insetLeft: 0.5, insetRight: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: d => `${c}, ${d.year}: ${fmtN(Math.round(d.value))} ${measureLabel}`
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    });
    const panel = html`<div class="sm-panel"><div class="sm-title">${c} <span class="sm-total">${fmtN(Math.round(total))}</span></div></div>`;
    panel.append(p);
    grid.append(panel);
  }
  return grid;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="dash-note">${view === "By hazard"
  ? "Bars show each year's total, split by hazard. The dark line is the three-year average. "
  : ""}${maxYear} is a partial year (data to ${lastUpdated}), shown paler. Canadian notices start in 2008, so totals before then are US only. Joint US and Canadian recalls count once.${measure === "Units recalled"
```

## Which parts cause which hazards {.dash-h2}

```{ojs}
html`<p class="dash-note">Each cell counts ${measureLabel} for one failed part and one hazard, using all your other filters. <strong>Click a cell</strong> to filter the whole dashboard to it, and click it again to clear.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
{
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const d of heatRows) {
    const k = d.failed_component + "|" + d.hazard_group;
    counts.set(k, (counts.get(k) ?? 0) + w(d));
  }
  const maxV = d3.max(counts.values()) || 1;
  const color = d3.scaleSequential([0, maxV], d3.interpolateRgbBasis(["#F3EEE3", "#8A9BEA", "#2340FF", "#141F80"]));
  const table = html`<table class="heat">
    <thead><tr><th></th>${hazards.map(h => html`<th scope="col">${h}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>`;
  const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
  for (const c of components) {
    const tr = html`<tr><th scope="row">${c}</th></tr>`;
    for (const h of hazards) {
      const v = counts.get(c + "|" + h) ?? 0;
      const selected = component === c && hazard === h;
      const td = html`<td tabindex="0">${v ? fmtN(Math.round(v)) : ""}</td>`;
      td.style.background = v ? color(Math.max(v, maxV * 0.12)) : "#ffffff";
      td.style.color = v > maxV * 0.5 ? "#ffffff" : "#111111";
      td.title = `${c}, ${h}: ${fmtN(Math.round(v))} ${measureLabel}`;
      if (selected) td.classList.add("selected");
      const pick = () => {
        setInput(viewof component, selected ? "All" : c);
        setInput(viewof hazard, selected ? "All" : h);
      };
      td.onclick = pick;
      td.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); pick(); } };
      tr.append(td);
    }
    tbody.append(tr);
  }
  const wrap = html`<div class="heat-wrap"></div>`;
  wrap.append(table);
  return wrap;
}
```

## United States and Canada {.dash-h2}

```{ojs}
html`<p class="dash-note">${measure} per year since 2008, when Canadian records begin, using all your other filters (the country boxes are ignored here). Joint recalls were announced in both countries.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
{
  const cats = ["US only", "Joint (both countries)", "Canada only"];
  const catColors = ["#2340FF", "#B9A4FF", "#FF5A36"];   // US cobalt, joint lilac, Canada tomato
  const yrs = d3.range(Math.max(lo, 2008), hi + 1);
  if (!yrs.length) return html`<p class="dash-note">Choose years from 2008 onward to compare the two countries.</p>`;
  const cat = d => {
    const set = eventCountries.get(d.event_id);
    if (set.size > 1) return "Joint (both countries)";
    return set.has("Canada") ? "Canada only" : "US only";
  };
  const rows = yrs.flatMap(y => cats.map(k => ({
    year: y, cat: k,
    value: d3.sum(countryRows.filter(d => d.recall_year === y && cat(d) === k), w)
  })));
  const fig = ebPlot(Plot, {
    width,
    height: 300,
    marginLeft: 56,
    x: {label: null, tickFormat: "d", domain: [yrs[0], hi + 1]},
    y: {label: measure === "Recall events" ? "Recall events per year" : "Units recalled per year", grid: true, tickFormat: "~s"},
    color: {domain: cats, range: catColors, legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(rows, {
        x: "year", interval: 1, y: "value", fill: "cat", order: cats,
        fillOpacity: d => d.year === maxYear ? 0.45 : 1,
        insetLeft: 1, insetRight: 1, stroke: eb.ink, strokeWidth: 0.5,
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.year}${d.year === maxYear ? " (partial year)" : ""}\n${d.cat}: ${fmtN(Math.round(d.value))} ${measureLabel}`
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
  const wrap = html`<div class="dash-chart"></div>`;
  wrap.append(fig);
  return wrap;
}
```

## Matching recalls {.dash-h2}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
listRows = filtered
  .map(d => ({
    year: d.recall_year,
    country: eventCountries.get(d.event_id).size > 1 ? "Both" : (d.country === "United States" ? "US" : "Canada"),
    title: d.title,
    url: d.url,
    what: d.product_form,
    part: d.failed_component,
    hazard: d.hazard_group,
    status: d.case_status
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.year - a.year)
```
